main_measure.name: t of slope of 2-bar forward return minus normal drift on range_pos post_pipeline_value (day-clustered)
main_measure.threshold: confirm t >= 2 with timing gain > 0; reject t <= -2; inconclusive otherwise or < 300 grid cases or < 100 distinct days

supporting_check.name: timing gain: book mean daily return minus market-rise gain, before costs

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the timing gain is above 0.
reading: Calm is the regime 'unknown', the expected side is the close above/below the middle of its 20-bar high-low range; the normal drift is the coin's mean 2-bar return on all grid bars of all its windows; the regression has an intercept with CR1 day-clustered errors; the book before costs is the held allocation times the next bar's close-to-close return, averaged over coins per day.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
